name: job-watch
summary: Use when a long local command must run in the background and be watched

exit_codes.0: started; status running or exited 0; wait saw exit 0; stop ended the group or had nothing to stop
exit_codes.1: start refused (name still running); status exited non-zero or lost; wait lost; stop refused or group survived
exit_codes.2: usage error or unknown job name
exit_codes.3: environment failure: missing dependency, unwritable state, or the job did not start
exit_codes.4: wait timed out with the job still running; otherwise wait returns the job's own exit status

distinct_from.reason: pr-flow polls GitHub pull request checks and workflow runs; job-watch starts and observes local background processes
